mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAY00033.insertPlRate */ INTO tb_pay_pl_rate_m ( pl_rate_id, subsidiary_code, paid_leave_detail_code, emp_category_code, tier_no, from_days, to_days , base_amount_type, base_salary_rate, position_allw_rate, job_allw_rate, qualification_allw_rate , adj1_allw_rate, adj2_allw_rate, adj3_allw_rate, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, note , creation_date, creation_user_id ) VALUES( sq_pay_pl_rate_id.NEXTVAL, #{subsidiaryCode}, #{paidLeaveDetailCode}, #{empCategoryCode}, #{tierNo}, #{fromDays}, #{toDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , NVL(#{baseAmountType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'BASE_SALARY') , NVL(#{baseSalaryRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{positionAllwRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{jobAllwRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{qualificationAllwRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , NVL(#{adj1AllwRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{adj2AllwRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{adj3AllwRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0) , TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(NVL(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '31/12/4712'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , SYSDATE, #{applicationUserId} )
mapper.delete: DELETE /* LGVPAY00033.deletePlRate */ FROM tb_pay_pl_rate_m WHERE pl_rate_id = #{plRateId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAY00033.retrievePlRateConflict */ a.paid_leave_detail_code , a.emp_category_code , a.tier_no AS tier_no_a , b.tier_no AS tier_no_b , TO_CHAR(GREATEST(a.effective_start_date, b.effective_start_date), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS conflict_date FROM tb_pay_pl_rate_m a , tb_pay_pl_rate_m b WHERE a.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} AND b.subsidiary_code = a.subsidiary_code AND b.paid_leave_detail_code = a.paid_leave_detail_code AND b.emp_category_code = a.emp_category_code AND b.pl_rate_id > a.pl_rate_id AND b.effective_start_date <= a.effective_end_date AND b.effective_end_date >= a.effective_start_date AND b.from_days <= NVL(a.to_days, 99999) AND NVL(b.to_days, 99999) >= a.from_days AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT /* LGVPAY00033.insertPlItemMap */ INTO tb_pay_pl_item_map_m ( pl_item_map_id, subsidiary_code, paid_leave_detail_code, tier_no, component_code , payroll_item_id, apply_value_type, note, creation_date, creation_user_id ) VALUES( sq_pay_pl_item_map_id.NEXTVAL, #{subsidiaryCode}, #{paidLeaveDetailCode}, #{tierNo}, #{componentCode} , #{payrollItemId}, NVL(#{applyValueType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PAY'), #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{applicationUserId} )
mapper.delete: DELETE /* LGVPAY00033.deletePlItemMap */ FROM tb_pay_pl_item_map_m WHERE pl_item_map_id = #{plItemMapId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAY00033.retrievePayrollItemList */ TO_CHAR(pi.payroll_item_id) AS code , pi.payroll_item_name AS name FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_m pi WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN pi.start_yyyymmdd AND NVL(pi.end_yyyymmdd, '47121231') ORDER BY pi.payroll_item_name
